title: When the gym server or WhatsApp is slow, the join, friend and invite pages and the sign-in code wait with no time limit
what: Our web server asks the gym server and WhatsApp with no time limit. When either is slow rather than down, a person sending the Become a member or Bring a friend form, opening a gym's invite link, or asking for a sign-in code sees a spinner until their own browser gives up, with no Try again message and no log line.
expected: Each outside call stops after a few seconds and the person sees a clear Try again message, with the reason logged.
how_often: whenever the gym server or WhatsApp is slow
fix_line: Give every outside call a time limit of a few seconds and answer Try again when it runs out

title: A short hiccup in our small web database tells the owner the AI Assistant is not switched on yet
what: If the small web database cannot be read for a moment, the owner's AI Assistant answers 'The AI Assistant is not switched on yet.' The owner thinks the feature is off for their gym, not that it is a passing fault.
expected: A passing fault says 'Something went wrong, try again in a minute', and only a real switch-off says not switched on.
fix_line: Use a separate try-again message for database faults

title: A feedback message or demo request sent again after a lost answer is saved twice
what: Send feedback and the free demo form save a new row every time. If the answer is lost on a slow line and the person taps send again, MettleUp gets the same message or the same gym's demo request twice.
expected: A repeat of the same send within a short time is recognised and saved once.
fix_line: Send a one-time id with each message and ignore a repeat of it

title: If WhatsApp number checks stop working, owners cannot reset a PIN or start a gym and MettleUp hears only from the gyms
what: Forgot PIN and the new-gym number check depend on WhatsApp. When Meta stops delivering codes or stops sending us the person's message (a payment block, a paused template, a changed secret), each failure is only a log line. Nothing counts failures or alerts anyone, so owners stay locked out until one calls MettleUp.
expected: Failed and unanswered WhatsApp checks are counted, and a run of failures alerts MettleUp within the hour.
fix_line: Count WhatsApp check failures in the small database and alert when they pass a limit

title: Nobody can tell how many people open a gym's invite, friend or join link, or how many then join
what: The invite, check-in, friend, Become a member and get-the-app pages count nothing. Only finished forms reach a gym, so MettleUp cannot see how many people open a link and give up, and decisions about these pages are made blind.
expected: A simple daily count per page of opens and finished forms, with no personal data.
fix_line: Add a daily count of page opens and finished forms per kind of page

items.reason: server code only: no heart rate, rest timer, workout clock or watch here; the one repeating job (10-minute payment check) is under L6.5
